9. A storage tank has the shape of an upside down
cone which is six feet across at the base and six
feet high. The tank is currently full of a liquid
with density50 lbs/ft3 and is being emptied by
being pumped out to a point 4 feet above the tip
of the cone. Determine the total work done in
emptying the tank.

14. You are engaged in your favorite hobby of
picking grapes and you are working along a
particular steep hill. At the bottom of the hill
your bag is empty and weighs 2 pounds; at the
top of the ﬁll you have gained in elevation 20 feet
and your bag now weighs17 pounds. If you
make the assumption that the grapes were added
in at a constant rate as you went up the ﬁll, then
determine the work done in moving the bags and
grapes up the hill.
